method: Source inspection and deterministic 200-seed samples where a pure API exists. Condition fingerprints exclude seed/identity. DOM continuation coverage is tools/arithmetic-supplements.dom.cjs; rounding preparation is covered by tools/rounding-stepwise.dom.cjs and tools/learning-rounding-preparation.dom.cjs; primary-route robots are separate. A finite set of mathematical facts is distinct from a UI that stops accepting attempts. This is not a claim that 119 URLs are 119 distinct engines or that every exam prototype has infinite new variants.

entries.title: Общий множитель: собери сумму в произведение
entries.explanation: Fixed teaching examples may repeat; practice is classified separately.

examples: Вынеси 4 за скобки в 4x + 32. Внутри скобки запиши коэффициент при x и число через ; (например, x + 3: 1; 3).
Вынеси -5 за скобки в -5x − 30. Внутри скобки запиши коэффициент при x и число через ; (например, x + 3: 1; 3).
Вынеси 6 за скобки в 6x − 42. Внутри скобки запиши коэффициент при x и число через ; (например, x + 3: 1; 3).
